scenes.title: Walmart isn't just a store
scenes.sub: Its fastest growth isn't on the shelves.
scenes.sub_html: Its fastest growth isn't on the shelves.

lines.say: Walmart brought in one hundred eighty eight point eight billion dollars in three months.
lines.show: Walmart brought in $188.8 billion in three months.

lines.say: But its fastest-growing businesses aren't on the shelves.
lines.show: But its fastest-growing businesses aren't on the shelves.

lines.say: Total revenue grew about five percent.

scenes.heading: Growth by business
scenes.source: Walmart, Q3 fiscal 2027, vs a year earlier

lines.say: Online sales and membership fees grew seventeen percent. Advertising grew twenty five.
lines.show: Online sales and membership fees grew 17%. Advertising grew 25%.

lines.say: Walmart still runs low-price stores. But members also pay a yearly fee for perks like delivery.
lines.show: Walmart still runs low-price stores. But members also pay a yearly fee for perks like delivery.

lines.say: Brands pay Walmart to show ads to shoppers on its app and website.
lines.show: Brands pay Walmart to show ads to shoppers on its app and website.

lines.say: And operating income grew sixteen percent. That's about three times as fast as revenue.
lines.show: And operating income grew 16%. That's about 3x as fast as revenue.

scenes.takeaway: Big stores now earn money beyond the shelf.
scenes.source: Data: Walmart Q3 fiscal 2027 results, SEC filing

lines.say: Follow H Flick for more business breakdowns like this.
lines.show: Follow HFLIC for more business breakdowns like this.

lines.say: And send this to the friend who basically lives at Walmart.
lines.show: And send this to the friend who basically lives at Walmart.
